results.title: People facing the sea
results.original_title: Des gens face à la mer
results.overview: A collection of moments, frozen in time through memories, photographs, and this movie. A journey from Brittany to the south of France, filled with conversations and swims. A film that captures youth and the sea in the summer of 2026.

results.title: Returning to Berneray
results.overview: In 1981 Allen Moore completed “The Shepherds of Berneray,” a study of the centuries-old crofting traditions of the island of Berneray, and a portrait of the Gaelic speaking people whose lives reflected the underpinnings of this heritage. Moore has continued a decades-long friendship with the islanders, and beginning in 2016, he spent 10 years revisiting the community to document what traditions have remained and how life has changed on the island. Weaving together 16mm outtakes from the late 1970’s with contemporary HD digital material, “Returning to Berneray” is a personal portrait of a place and a filmmaker’s relationship to it.

results.title: Little Pieces
results.overview: Alice returns to her estranged aunt's home to collect family photographs after her death. This simple errand unearths a buried family secret, pieced together from fragmented visions and stilted conversations with her mother. Reeling from the discovery, Alice reflects on what we inherit from our families and what we release.

results.title: Rainy Day
results.overview: Small-time crook Victor Varnavas thinks he’s struck gold when kindly Beryl Cooke invites him into her home, until he discovers he can’t have his cake and eat it too.

results.title: EXP. MASC. AD
results.overview: An archival short film built from videos recorded in 2011 on a Nokia 5230 during the filmmaker’s high school years, when filming was simply an act of capturing without a defined purpose. Fifteen years later, those images are reinterpreted through editing on a Samsung A26. Through playful and violent fragments, the film explores the adolescent heterosexual masculine experience, while reflecting on the evolution of the mobile phone as a tool that first democratized audiovisual recording and, by 2026, also made editing more accessible.

results.title: CHAI
results.overview: Two years after a defeat that kept him away from the ring, Henry flies to Thailand to join Saenchai, a legend of Thai boxing. Several weeks at his training camp, a rare immersion in his culture and family, and finally, a real fight. CHAI is the film chronicling this adventure and exploring a universal question: How far must one go to confront one’s fears?

results.title: Shoot the Messenger
results.overview: A bike-messenger trapped in an immigration scam finds himself in a sticky situation as things get violent.

results.title: Fortaleza
results.overview: Brazil is preparing to welcome the world. Isadora is preparing to claim her place in it.

results.title: Clubfoot
results.overview: After fleeing his unstable home, an adopted teenager and his only friend abduct and violently assault a younger boy. As night falls, their lives begin  to unravel.

results.title: With You
results.overview: A woman’s travels unfold on screen while a man’s letters reach out to her from afar.

results.title: Sand Roads
results.overview: SAND ROADS is a journey told in two chapters - one filled with the spirit of youth; the other imbued with the weight of adulthood - showing the eternal struggle for self-discovery, adventure and how friendships can transcend life itself.

results.title: Dragoons
results.overview: The documentary delves into the images that shaped the political myth of Jair Bolsonaro, from his earliest YouTube videos to the end of his term in office. Over a series of sleepless nights, a narrator drifts through Bolsonaro’s livestreams, selfies, and speeches, searching for the logic of a form of power forged through and by images. By confronting this visual regime with Brazil’s official iconography, the film explores how power is understood, repeated, and asserted through images, at a time when politics increasingly unfolds on screens.

results.title: Barbizon
results.overview: A stalled sculptor, on the verge of giving up art to study law with her on-again boyfriend, escapes to the Hamptons and takes a job teaching chess to wealthy families.

results.title: a little bird finds its way home
results.overview: Family members gather to share memories of their beloved mother and grandmother, Noklek. Captured through the lens of her funeral. Little do they realize that never-before-seen footage will soon reveal her final words.

results.title: A Stolen Movie
results.overview: Camilo Restrepo reappropriates and remixes a real General Motors promotional film depicting an early-1960s exhibition across the Darién Gap in Chevrolet Corvairs. As the representatives of the global North’s industrial might bridge the same chasm that stands between today’s migrants and the United States, Restrepo considers the unequal flows of people and property between the Americas.

results.title: Sunshine
results.overview: An adult man trapped in a state of early adolescence due to his heavily overbearing mother, must defy the rules he has known all his life in order to break free from her authoritative influence.

results.title: The Windy Day
results.overview: A single kite string ties four kids together through childhood, friendship, and loss. As their bond begins to unravel, they are forced to confront what it means to grow apart and leave the past behind.

results.title: Next Year
results.overview: Next Year is a haunting drama set in the not so distant dystopian future that unfolds in a fractured America where homosexuality is illegal and surveillance reigns. The story centers on Robert, a grieving father who is navigating life after the loss of his husband and the terrifying state of the country.

results.title: Mnemotechnics
results.overview: A visual representation of the neurological degradation of an elderly person through the perspective of a family member.
